name: labs/azdagkas__kinesis-piezo
title: Thorlabs TPZ001 piezo controller (piezo.PiezoController)
intro: Thorlabs TPZ001 piezo controller (piezo.PiezoController), adapted from azdagkas/kinesis-piezo. It reads `units`, `reader_reading`, `reader_units` and `zeroing`; sets `value` and `closed_loop`; runs `move_to_home`, `jog_up`, `jog_down`, `calibrate_position` and 2 more. `move_to_home`: drive the piezo travel to zero with the native move_to_home (the safe state). A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
